title: Fixed Radial Cord Ring and Perimeter Wheel Table
description: One newly authored whole static round-table cord-and-weight exhibit. Three complete radial feet support a central pedestal and one thick blank circular table. Three independent pairs of edge bearing cheeks hold complete tangent-axis grooved wheels. Three whole continuous cords join one genuinely empty central ring, diverge across open air above the tabletop, wrap over their respective perimeter wheel and descend to three whole shouldered hanging weights. All construction newly authored; no old incline, ceiling fixture, table or pulley mesh imported. Not the single slotted inclined board with a sliding block, nor two ceiling lift bridles routed to a wall cleat. One model, zero scenes. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres and centred ground datum. Fixed illustrative appearance only: no real equilibrium, mass, force, tension, angle calibration, rope motion, working adjustment, experiment, teaching result, load, manufacture or safety claim. No graduations, numbers or equations. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
